== Title ==
<span lang="ja">レイア</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
The printed game-text box is blank.

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">オルデランの総督兼第一議長の養女。若くして政治的な<u>リーダー</u>となる。皇帝の勅令の非道さに反発して、反乱軍に加わった。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Leia.

'''Lore''' — Adopted daughter of Alderaan’s governor and first chairman. She became a political leader at a young age. She joined the Rebellion in opposition to the cruelty of the Emperor’s edicts.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

Both faces have a blank game-text box. The original English lore refers to the injustices of the New Order. The Japanese lore refers to the cruelty of the Emperor’s edicts.<ref>[[:File:Jedi-L-leia.gif|Original English face]], [[Leia (Jedi Pack)]].</ref>
